title: Dijkstra as an Oracle for Online Stochastic Shortest Path Navigation with Provable Guarantees
abstract: arXiv:2608.17703v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Mobile robots that operate in side by side with humans and critical facilities must reach their goals at low cost, despite often unknown true traversal costs of the map apriori and imperfect actuation. Planners that solve the underlying stochastic shortest path problem exactly, such as value iteration, require computation that grows with the diameter of the map, whereas Dijkstra's algorithm is fast but is usually considered inexact once transitions are stochastic. This study shows that Dijkstra's algorithm can remain an exact planning engine under a condition that is much weaker than the causality condition often invoked in the literature, namely nonnegativity of a reduced cost defined on the determinized map. translated_title: 迪杰斯特拉作为在线随机最短路径导航的预言机，具有可证明的保证
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.17703v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：与人类和关键设施并排运行的移动机器人必须以低成本到达目标，尽管地图的真实穿越成本通常事先未知且执行不完美。精确解决底层随机最短路径问题的规划器，如值迭代，其计算量随地图直径增长，而迪杰斯特拉算法速度快，但通常在转移变为随机时被认为不精确。本研究表明，迪杰斯特拉算法可以在一个比文献中常引用的因果条件弱得多的条件下保持精确规划引擎的作用，即定义在确定化地图上的简化成本的非负性。基于这一特征，提出了一种在线学习器DORA（迪杰斯特拉预言机简化成本算法），用于机器人导航，它每集调用固定次数的最短路径预言机，且从不估计转移概率。
tldr: 本文提出DORA算法，证明了迪杰斯特拉算法在弱于因果条件的非负简化成本条件下可作为精确规划引擎，并以固定预言机调用次数实现可证明保证的在线随机最短路径导航。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes DORA, proving Dijkstra's algorithm remains exact under a weaker nonnegative reduced-cost condition, enabling online stochastic shortest path navigation with fixed oracle calls and provable guarantees.
